## Fourth Global Coral Bleaching Event Set a Record for Heat-Stress Exposure

The fourth global coral bleaching event was confirmed on April 15, 2024. Satellite data recorded bleaching-level heat stress across roughly 84.4% of global reef area from January 2023 through September 2025. Mass bleaching was documented in at least 83 countries and territories.

The measured heat-stress footprint exceeded the 68.2% recorded during the 2014–2017 event. That makes the event record-setting by area exposed to bleaching-level heat stress—not evidence that every exposed reef bleached or died.
